notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on Robertson County, District 6 and removal. The record's agency (Tennessee Division of Forestry) matches Forest Lookouts; the record's elevation 195.1 m matches 640 ft. No NHLR or firetower.org entry exists in the local caches. Nothing found on construction, design, staffing, fires or the site today, so the story is short (about 125 words) because the evidence does not support more. Record status 'gone' is consistent with 'removed'; no correction proposed. Searches: one per tower plus one shared search for the 1933-1975 MPDF; the MPDF search returned no page text for this tower.
